---
title: eQTL Catalogue
description: The eQTL Catalogue's dataset metadata as a resource table, with summary statistics and credible sets referenced by URI on the EBI FTP.
---

The [eQTL Catalogue](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/) (EMBL-EBI and the University
of Tartu) reprocesses public QTL studies uniformly and publishes, per dataset
(one study, sample group and quantification method), tabix-indexed summary
statistics and fine-mapping results on the EBI FTP. The release lands the two
metadata files of a numbered Catalogue release from the
[resources repository](https://github.com/eQTL-Catalogue/eQTL-Catalogue-resources)
and derives `resource.eqtlcatalogue__dataset`: what was measured, in which
tissue or cell type, and the three FTP URIs. No summary statistic is copied.

## Licence and citation

CC BY 4.0 ([ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/License](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/License)).
Cite the Catalogue release as [its site asks](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/).

## Join keys

- `dataset_id` (`QTD000001`) is the key of all three tables.
- `tissue_term_id` is a UBERON, CL or EFO CURIE that joins `ontology.term.term_id` (BTO is not landed), and is a row in `resource.resource_relationship`.
- `pmid` joins `annotation.pubmed__article` and `annotation.icite__publication`.

## Good to know

- Attributes come from the metadata file, which upstream keeps correcting; only the URIs come from the paths file, and the two must name the same datasets or nothing lands.
- Credible sets are referenced by `credible_sets_uri` and not landed; the GTEx v8 imported files are not landed either.
